title: Sodium Night
subtitle: a six-shot short
logline: Last bus. Wet street. One passenger who does not get off clean.

shots.title: Empty deck
shots.action: Lower deck, one body. Rain on the glass. Sodium smear.

shots.title: Window
shots.action: Bruise, wet hood, lamp through the pane. He does not look at the camera.

shots.title: The bell
shots.action: Same seat, tighter. The street slides. He has already decided.

shots.title: Off the bus
shots.action: Rain vertical. Door light. One step onto the wet road.

shots.title: Over the shoulder
shots.action: The bus is gone from the frame. Lamps recede. He checks the empty street.

shots.title: Into the sodium
shots.action: He walks the wet line of lamps. End.
